## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `64cb4e0780f3e3abaac26d658ee7978bfd284302`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card #20939 (body + all 4 comments), PR #20973 (body, file list, net diff against `main` at `5f6b63a6f`, merge-base `d7b98176`), the 35 check-runs on the head, and the rule files at `origin/main` (`docs/NORTH-STAR.md` line 13, `docs/qa/platform-checklist/README.md`, `RUNNER.md`, `runs/README.md`, `runs/.gitignore`, `scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` header + enums, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md`). Face hit: governed text (`docs/NORTH-STAR.md`, Tier H). No `content/docs/**`, `apps/docs/**`, CHANGELOG/`.changeset` prose or `packages/spec/src/**` in the diff. Diff = 3 files, +91 −3, all under `docs/`.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **`docs/NORTH-STAR.md` — one-token flip, right.** The net diff on this file is exactly line 24's 「清单项待写」 → `doc-on-app-menu`; nothing else on the file moves. Row shape `轴 · 功能点 · 清单区 · 项 id` is intact. Line 13's rule — an id without a prefix belongs to the area named before it, cross-area ids are written in full — resolves the bare token to `studio-authoring.doc-on-app-menu` (the row's 清单区 is `studio-authoring + platform-core`; every other `A + B` row in the file, lines 28/73/74/75/89, spells A's ids bare and B's in full, so the convention is the file's own). That id exists in this diff. No 「清单项待写」 row remains after the flip. `Governed Surface Queue Guard` check-run: success.

2. **The new item asserts only what the rulings and the triage direction support — right.**
   - UI-mirror clause (acceptance[1]) is scoped to entries "that name an installed doc or book", with the dangling-entry carve-out — the objectui review correction `5919164226` ③ (h) the card and triage `5919682769` both require.
   - No signed-out persona: `personas` are seeded admin / reader / outsider only; `history[0].change` records why (`/docs` behind `ProtectedRoute`). Read at objectui `d6a1a80d5d`: `apps/console/src/App.tsx:288` routes `/docs` inside the protected tree.
   - Neighbours cited, not merged: `platform-core.docs-audience-gate` and `platform-core.docs-portal-render` appear in `negative` (SCOPE line), `source`, and `history`; the item owns the app-menu entry, its mirror and the direct-route refusal; API-grain audience semantics and the portal's own rendering are explicitly left to them. Triage's ⛔ "do not merge them" holds.
   - Re-derivations against the card's draft are each correct: the `area` key dropped (no item in `studio-authoring.json` carries one; `area` is file-level); `surface: mixed` (clauses use `api` + `dom` + `screenshot` oracles; `mixed` is in the gate's `SURFACES`, and 12 of the area's 15 items use it); `oracle` values `api`/`dom`/`screenshot` are all in the gate's `ORACLES`; the five `traps` (`auth-state-leak`, `hydration-race`, `wrong-persona`, `stale-console-bundle`, `cache-staleness`) are all rows of RUNNER.md 〈Trap vocabulary〉; `revision: 1` equals the last `history` entry; `status: active` with a passing first run is the README's "promotion is earned" reading; `priority: P1` is the card's.
   - Clause 3's sharpened `verify` ("never wider; narrower is not a FAIL") keeps the audience assertion the card asked for (a gated doc absent from a book the outsider can open; every sidebar entry inside the member's tree) and defers only the tree-shape divergence to the neighbours. It narrows the claim to what is enforced; it does not widen it. See ③ (c) for the divergence itself.

3. **Every factual claim in the item is true on `origin/main` (or on the objectui revisions the item names).**
   - `since: v17.5`: `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` `## 17.5.0` carries `ccccdcc` (new `type: 'doc'` nav member + exported `DocNavItemSchema`); `packages/rest/CHANGELOG.md` `## 17.5.0` carries `bc80e16` (`GET /meta/app` leaves out a `doc` entry the caller may not read, #19790). Current `spec`/`rest`/`cli` versions are `17.5.0`, so it is also the README's "new-capability items land with `since:` the current release". Matches the gate's `RELEASE_RE`.
   - `source` symbol anchors resolve: `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts#DocNavItemSchema` is an `export const` at line 705; `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts#filterAppForUser` is an `export function` at line 925. `NavDocAudienceGate` exists (line 385) and its docblock says the arm "FAILS CLOSED … an absent gate prunes every `doc` entry" — the item's parenthetical is a quote of the contract, not an invention. Both anchors are top-level exports, so they only add to the family's shrink-never floor.
   - `ADR-0046 §6.7` exists ("Access & URL surface — docs are anonymous-capable, apps are not"); `ADR-0054` is the runtime-proof gate the REPO OWNERSHIP line leans on; dogfood `§0` ("起飞前 —— 先隔离环境") exists.
   - knownGaps recipe facts: the platform's default audience posture is `invite_only` when undeclared (`plugin-auth/src/audience-posture.ts:136,248`) and the showcase config declares none → "the showcase is invite_only" holds; `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/create-user` with `mustChangePassword` exists (`admin-user-endpoints.ts:13`, tests at lines 220–259); `POST /api/v1/packages` accepts a bare manifest `{id, name, version, type}` (`packages-install-body-contract.test.ts` header: "a wrapped request or a bare manifest"); the 422 text "Pick or create a writable base (package) first" is objectui `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts:252` at `d6a1a80d5d`; `showcase_auditor` is a stock permission set (`examples/app-showcase/src/security/permission-sets.ts:165`); the showcase app is `showcase_app` (`src/ui/apps/index.ts:22`); `GET /meta/app?id=` narrows the list (#7566 tests); `GET /meta/book/:name/tree` is a live route; the admin-refused-after-claim fact is the documented fail-closed design (see ③ (b)).
   - FORK WINDOW: `.objectui-sha` at `origin/main` is `db11afd4967c`; `git grep` at that revision in `../objectui` finds no "You do not have access to this documentation" and no `checkDocTarget` / `useNavDocTargetCheck` / `DocRefusal`; at `d6a1a80d5d` all of them exist (`packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx`, `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useNavDocTargetCheck.ts`, `apps/console/src/pages/BookPage.tsx` / `DocPage.tsx` / `DocsSlug.tsx`, `book-nav.ts` `homeBook` + `resolveBookTree`), and `02fe8ca8a0` (PR 11241) is an ancestor of `d6a1a80d5d`. The item's `requires[3]` and knownGaps[1] state exactly this.
   - The two ruling-comment ids in `source` (`5754645447` on #19482, `5793362670` on #19790) are carried from the card body as the objectui seat and triage recorded them; they are outside this brief's input set and are not re-fetched here.

4. **`coverage.json` — consistent with its own rules, right.** The file's `$comment` keys the map by liveness LEDGER NAME and asks every kind to be mapped to ≥1 item; `packages/spec/liveness/doc.json` and `book.json` both exist, and the diff appends `studio-authoring.doc-on-app-menu` under exactly `doc` and `book`, beside the two neighbours, touching nothing else. The id resolves to an `active` item, so it CARRIES coverage under the gate's `COVERAGE_BEARING_STATUSES`. Nit, not a defect: the server half anchors the `app` filter (`filterAppForUser`), so an `app`-kind mapping would also have been legitimate; omitting it breaks no rule.

5. **Check-runs on the head: 35, all `completed`; every conclusion is `success` or `skipped`, none failed.** `Check Changeset`, `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, both claim guards and `Check Documentation Links` are green. `pnpm check:platform-checklist` is not per-PR CI by standing decision (README 〈Operating cadence〉, RUNNER.md top), so its red is the watchdog's, not this head's; the dev's control run says the one problem (`identity-auth.json` → `auth-plugin.ts#twoFactor`) is identical on `main` and this diff adds none — consistent with the two new anchors resolving statically (point 3).

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: no` — right, and the PR body carries it at line start. The diff publishes nothing: no `packages/**` file, no `.changeset/*`, no CHANGELOG line; the only governed surface is `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`, which is a review face (this record), not a published accept set. Labels `skip-changeset` + `documentation`; `Check Changeset` check-run: success. The item's `since: v17.5` describes an accept-set change that already shipped in 17.5.0 (`ccccdcc`, `bc80e16`) — it names it, it does not re-publish it.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev report `5921712708` (`session_01RUy93pSQMTtKhN5paYkN1C`): 4 `deviations`, 1 `open_questions`, 4 `out_of_scope_findings`. Each answered:

- **open_questions[0] — where the first run record lives (A qa-run issue / B committed `runs/` file): A, and the seat's ACCEPT answer is right.** RUNNER.md 〈Run records — the GitHub issue is the report〉: "Every completed run … files one GitHub issue … labeled `qa-run` … Nothing lands in the repo — not the JSON, not screenshots; `runs/` is git-ignored except its README." `runs/.gitignore` is `*` + `!.gitignore` + `!README.md`; `runs/README.md` title is "results are NOT committed". The dispatch's "one new run record under `runs/`" was the wrong carrier and the standing text wins. The dev's title line (`QA run · studio-authoring.doc-on-app-menu (1/1) · f6ccca4a · 2026-09-30 · 1 PASS / 0 PARTIAL / 0 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN`) has the ruling's five middle-dot fields, an 8-hex sha, a bare `(1/1)`, and all five uppercase buckets in order. The seat states it filed #20975 from the PR body's verification section; that issue is outside this brief's input set and is the seat's to own — the PR body itself carries the full text record (env fingerprint incl. pin + driven objectui revision, scope + revision, per-clause table with text evidence, no images), which is the RUNNER body contract.
- **deviations[0] (run record not in tree; qa-run issue not filed by the dev, write budget):** same answer as above; correct behaviour.
- **deviations[1] (`npm_config_engine_strict=false` for the console build; jsdom's node floor):** environment only; `jsdom` is a test dependency, not in the console bundle; nothing in the diff depends on it. Accepted as recorded.
- **deviations[2] (`.objectui-sha` set to `d6a1a80d5d` in the working tree for the run only, restored):** verified — the diff's file list is the three `docs/` files; `.objectui-sha` at `origin/main` is unchanged `db11afd496`. This is RUNNER.md's "two honest options" (b) with the revision named, and the item's FORK WINDOW knownGap plus the `stale-console-bundle` trap make the next runner do the same. Accepted.
- **deviations[3] (shared checkout was on the branch at dispatch; detached, worktree hosted, returned):** process only; no trace in the diff. Accepted.
- **out_of_scope_findings (a) — pre-existing `check:platform-checklist` red (`identity-auth.json` ABSENT SYMBOL `auth-plugin.ts#twoFactor`):** not this diff's (the file is untouched; the two anchors this diff adds resolve). The watchdog is the standing carrier; the seat's ACCEPT names #20464 / #20559 as the cards — not verified here (outside inputs). Nothing owed by this PR.
- **out_of_scope_findings (b) — an admin not holding the set is refused in the Studio editor over the doc they just published once a `{ permissionSet }` book claims it:** by design, not a defect. `meta-item-read-gate.ts`: the author exemption (`mayWriteItem`) is honoured only where a door's policy is `author-exempt` (the app read), and the docs audience resolves through `resolvePermissionSetNames` and DENIES a permission-set audience the caller does not hold (fail closed, ADR-0049; ADR-0046 §6.7). A platform admin holding no set is outside the audience by contract. Recording it as a knownGaps recipe fact ("author the doc before the gated book, or read it back as the reader") is the right carrier; the editor's banner-over-pending-editor UX is objectui's and would be a UX card there, not owed by this diff.
- **out_of_scope_findings (c) — `GET /meta/book/B/tree`'s synthetic Uncategorized group spans every package while the portal resolves it per package: escalated to the seat.** The divergence is real and has a locatable cause: `packages/spec/src/system/book.zod.ts` `resolveBookTree(book, docs, bookPackage?)` scopes a group's `include` by `group.package ?? bookPackage` but computes the orphans (the Uncategorized group) over every doc passed in; the REST answer passes `book._packageId` (`meta-item-read-gate.ts:608`), and objectui's port (`book-nav.ts` `scopeDocsToBook` → `resolveBookTree`) scopes the docs to the book's package first. Both were audience-correct in the run, and the item's clause 3 is honest about it ("narrower is not a FAIL, wider is") while keeping the audience assertion. Whether the server's cross-package orphan group is the ADR-0046 §6 intent or a contract drift belongs to `platform-core.docs-audience-gate` / `docs-portal-render`'s owner: the seat should file one card (or ask the ruling) rather than leave it in Acceptance notes only — AGENTS.md rule 10 files a contract question, and this one is reproducible from the recipe in the item. Not a FAIL of this diff: the diff neither introduces nor advertises the divergence.
- **out_of_scope_findings (d) — container node `22.22.0` below objectui's engine-strict floor via jsdom `^22.22.2`:** environment note; no carrier; no effect on the diff.

Nits, none blocking: `history[0].ref` is the card (`#20939`) where the README example shows `#PR` — non-binding; an `app`-kind mapping in `coverage.json` would also have been legitimate (① 4).

Implemented-by: `session_01RUy93pSQMTtKhN5paYkN1C`
Reviewed-by: `session_01JAhu8u8QfBvRjVZDox7CP9`

**VERDICT: PASS**

**席位意见**:建议批准。

- 复核发现一处服务端与门户的口径分歧:书目录的「未分类」组会收进别的包的文档,与 ADR-0046 §6.4 不符。这不是本 PR 引入的,已另立 #20980,不影响本次落地。
